## Load functions
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Resolved human protein complexes: Input directories
# ============================================================

human_complexes_dir <- file.path(
  ".",
  "codes_Github_final",
  "data",
  "resolved_human_protein_complexes"
)

# Check input directories
list.dirs(
  human_complexes_dir,
  recursive = FALSE
)



# ============================================================
# Function: Read FreeSASA RSA file
# ============================================================

read_freesasa_rsa <- function(
    pdb_id,
    base_dir = human_complexes_dir
) {

  rsa_file <- file.path(
    base_dir,
    "rsa",
    paste0(pdb_id, "_freesasa.rsa")
  )

  rsa_lines <- readLines(rsa_file)

  rsa_residue_lines <- rsa_lines[
    grepl("^RES\\s", rsa_lines)
  ]

  # Parse residue name, chain and residue number
  rsa_identity_matrix <- stringr::str_match(
    rsa_residue_lines,
    "^RES\\s+([A-Za-z0-9]+)\\s+([^\\s0-9+-]+|[A-Za-z0-9]+?)\\s*([+-]?[0-9]+)\\s+"
  )

  rsa_identity <- tibble::tibble(
    residue_name = rsa_identity_matrix[, 2],
    chain = rsa_identity_matrix[, 3],
    residue_number = as.integer(
      rsa_identity_matrix[, 4]
    )
  )

  # Remove prefix and parse numerical SASA/RSA values
  rsa_numeric_text <- stringr::str_remove(
    rsa_residue_lines,
    "^RES\\s+[A-Za-z0-9]+\\s+[^\\s]*?\\s*[+-]?[0-9]+\\s+"
  )

  rsa_numeric <- utils::read.table(
    text = rsa_numeric_text,
    header = FALSE,
    fill = TRUE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    na.strings = "N/A"
  )

  names(rsa_numeric) <- c(
    "ASA_total",
    "RSA_total",
    "ASA_sidechain",
    "RSA_sidechain",
    "ASA_mainchain",
    "RSA_mainchain",
    "ASA_nonpolar",
    "RSA_nonpolar",
    "ASA_polar",
    "RSA_polar"
  )

  dplyr::bind_cols(
    rsa_identity,
    rsa_numeric
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      chain = as.character(chain),
      pdb_id = pdb_id
    )
}


# ============================================================
# Function: Read chain mapping
# ============================================================

read_chain_mapping <- function(
    pdb_id,
    base_dir = human_complexes_dir
) {

  mapping_file <- file.path(
    base_dir,
    "chain_mapping",
    paste0(pdb_id, "_chain_mapping.csv")
  )

  readr::read_csv(
    mapping_file,
    show_col_types = FALSE,
    col_types = readr::cols(
      auth_chain = readr::col_character(),
      label_chain = readr::col_character(),
      .default = readr::col_guess()
    )
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      auth_chain = as.character(auth_chain)
    )
}


# ============================================================
# Function: Read ChimeraX residue contacts
# ============================================================

read_chimerax_contacts <- function(
    pdb_id,
    base_dir = human_complexes_dir
) {

  contact_file <- file.path(
    base_dir,
    "atom_contacts",
    paste0(pdb_id, "_residue_contacts_5A.txt")
  )

  contact_lines <- readLines(contact_file)

  contact_lines <- contact_lines[
    grepl("^\\s*/", contact_lines)
  ]

  contacts <- utils::read.table(
    text = contact_lines,
    header = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    fill = TRUE
  )

  names(contacts) <- c(
    "chain_1",
    "residue_1",
    "position_1",
    "chain_2",
    "residue_2",
    "position_2",
    "distance"
  )

  contacts %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      chain_1 = stringr::str_remove(
        chain_1,
        "^/"
      ),

      chain_2 = stringr::str_remove(
        chain_2,
        "^/"
      ),

      chain_1 = as.character(chain_1),
      chain_2 = as.character(chain_2),

      position_1 = as.integer(position_1),
      position_2 = as.integer(position_2),

      distance = as.numeric(distance),

      pdb_id = pdb_id
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      chain_1 != chain_2
    )
}


# ============================================================
# Process human protein complexes
# ============================================================

process_complex <- function(
  complex_name,
  pdb_id
) {
  
  message(
    "Processing ",
    complex_name,
    " (",
    pdb_id,
    ")"
  )
  
  # ==========================================================
  # Load inputs
  # ==========================================================
  
  rsa <- read_freesasa_rsa(
    pdb_id
  )
  
  mapping <- read_chain_mapping(
    pdb_id
  )
  
  contacts <- read_chimerax_contacts(
    pdb_id
  )
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # Keep polymer mapping only
  #
  # Ligands can share auth_chain IDs with proteins,
  # so they must not enter chain-based joins.
  # ==========================================================
  
  mapping_polymer <- mapping %>%
    filter(
      component_type %in%
        c(
          "protein",
          "DNA",
          "RNA",
          "DNA/RNA"
        )
    )
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # Check for duplicated auth-chain mappings
  # ==========================================================
  
  duplicated_mapping <- mapping_polymer %>%
    count(
      auth_chain
    ) %>%
    filter(
      n > 1
    )
  
  if (nrow(duplicated_mapping) > 0) {
    
    message(
      "Warning: ",
      pdb_id,
      " has duplicated polymer auth_chain IDs."
    )
    
  }
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # Build master protein-residue table from FreeSASA
  # ==========================================================
  
  protein_residues <- rsa %>%
    left_join(
      mapping_polymer,
      by = c(
        "chain" = "auth_chain"
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      component_type == "protein"
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      complex = complex_name,
      pdb_id = pdb_id,
      chain,
      label_chain,
      entity_id,
      protein = entity_description,
      residue_number,
      residue_name,
      ASA_total,
      RSA_total
    )
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # Annotate both sides of contact table
  # ==========================================================
  
  contacts_annotated <- contacts %>%
    
    left_join(
      mapping_polymer %>%
        select(
          auth_chain,
          component_type,
          entity_description
        ),
      by = c(
        "chain_1" = "auth_chain"
      )
    ) %>%
    
    rename(
      component_type_1 =
        component_type,
      
      component_1 =
        entity_description
    ) %>%
    
    left_join(
      mapping_polymer %>%
        select(
          auth_chain,
          component_type,
          entity_description
        ),
      by = c(
        "chain_2" = "auth_chain"
      )
    ) %>%
    
    rename(
      component_type_2 =
        component_type,
      
      component_2 =
        entity_description
    )
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # Keep macromolecular contacts
  # ==========================================================
  
  contacts_biological <-
    contacts_annotated %>%
    
    filter(
      component_type_1 %in%
        c(
          "protein",
          "DNA",
          "RNA",
          "DNA/RNA"
        ),
      
      component_type_2 %in%
        c(
          "protein",
          "DNA",
          "RNA",
          "DNA/RNA"
        )
    )
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # Put protein contacts from both sides into long format
  # ==========================================================
  
  interface_side_1 <-
    contacts_biological %>%
    
    filter(
      component_type_1 == "protein"
    ) %>%
    
    transmute(
      chain = chain_1,
      residue_number = position_1,
      residue_name = residue_1,
      partner_chain = chain_2,
      partner_component_type =
        component_type_2,
      partner_component =
        component_2,
      distance
    )
  
  
  interface_side_2 <-
    contacts_biological %>%
    
    filter(
      component_type_2 == "protein"
    ) %>%
    
    transmute(
      chain = chain_2,
      residue_number = position_2,
      residue_name = residue_2,
      partner_chain = chain_1,
      partner_component_type =
        component_type_1,
      partner_component =
        component_1,
      distance
    )
  
  
  interface_contacts_long <-
    bind_rows(
      interface_side_1,
      interface_side_2
    )
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # Collapse to one row per protein residue
  # ==========================================================
  
  interface_residue_summary <-
    interface_contacts_long %>%
    
    group_by(
      chain,
      residue_number,
      residue_name
    ) %>%
    
    summarise(
      
      has_contact = TRUE,
      
      min_contact_distance =
        min(
          distance,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
      
      n_contact_pairs = n(),
      
      n_partner_chains =
        n_distinct(
          partner_chain
        ),
      
      has_protein_contact =
        any(
          partner_component_type ==
            "protein"
        ),
      
      has_DNA_contact =
        any(
          partner_component_type %in%
            c(
              "DNA",
              "DNA/RNA"
            )
        ),
      
      has_RNA_contact =
        any(
          partner_component_type %in%
            c(
              "RNA",
              "DNA/RNA"
            )
        ),
      
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # Merge RSA and interface information
  # ==========================================================
  
  residue_classes <-
    protein_residues %>%
    
    left_join(
      interface_residue_summary,
      by = c(
        "chain",
        "residue_number",
        "residue_name"
      )
    ) %>%
    
    mutate(
      
      has_contact =
        replace_na(
          has_contact,
          FALSE
        ),
      
      n_contact_pairs =
        replace_na(
          n_contact_pairs,
          0L
        ),
      
      n_partner_chains =
        replace_na(
          n_partner_chains,
          0L
        ),
      
      has_protein_contact =
        replace_na(
          has_protein_contact,
          FALSE
        ),
      
      has_DNA_contact =
        replace_na(
          has_DNA_contact,
          FALSE
        ),
      
      has_RNA_contact =
        replace_na(
          has_RNA_contact,
          FALSE
        )
    )
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # Final structural classification
  # ==========================================================
  
  residue_classes <-
    residue_classes %>%
    
    mutate(
      
      structural_class =
        case_when(
          
          has_contact ~
            "Interface",
          
          RSA_total <= 25 ~
            "Core",
          
          RSA_total > 25 ~
            "Non-interface Surface",
          
          TRUE ~
            NA_character_
        ),
      
      
      interface_type =
        case_when(
          
          has_protein_contact &
            has_DNA_contact &
            has_RNA_contact ~
            "Protein + DNA + RNA",
          
          has_protein_contact &
            has_DNA_contact ~
            "Protein + DNA",
          
          has_protein_contact &
            has_RNA_contact ~
            "Protein + RNA",
          
          has_DNA_contact &
            has_RNA_contact ~
            "DNA + RNA",
          
          has_protein_contact ~
            "Protein",
          
          has_DNA_contact ~
            "DNA",
          
          has_RNA_contact ~
            "RNA",
          
          TRUE ~
            NA_character_
        ),
      
      
      # Keeps identical copies distinguishable
      protein_copy =
        paste0(
          protein,
          "__chain_",
          chain
        )
    )
  
  
  # ==========================================================
  # QC
  # ==========================================================
  
  unmatched_interfaces <-
    anti_join(
      interface_residue_summary,
      protein_residues,
      by = c(
        "chain",
        "residue_number",
        "residue_name"
      )
    )
  
  
  qc <- tibble(
    complex = complex_name,
    pdb_id = pdb_id,
    n_protein_residues =
      nrow(
        protein_residues
      ),
    n_interface_residues =
      sum(
        residue_classes$has_contact
      ),
    n_unclassified =
      sum(
        is.na(
          residue_classes$structural_class
        )
      ),
    n_unmatched_interface_residues =
      nrow(
        unmatched_interfaces
      )
  )
  
  
  list(
    residues =
      residue_classes,
    
    contacts =
      contacts_biological,
    
    interface_contacts_long =
      interface_contacts_long,
    
    unmatched_interfaces =
      unmatched_interfaces,
    
    qc =
      qc
  )
}




```



## Process structural data

# Run all complexes
complex_results <- purrr::map2(
  complexes$complex,
  complexes$pdb_id,
  process_complex
)

names(complex_results) <-
  complexes$pdb_id

names(complex_results)

  complex_results %>%
  purrr::map(
    "residues"
  ) %>%
  bind_rows()

human_complex_residues %>%
  count(

# ============================================================
# Examine unmatched residues in FreeSASA
# ============================================================

check_unmatched_residues <- function(pdb_id) {

  rsa <- read_freesasa_rsa(pdb_id)

  unmatched <-
    complex_results[[pdb_id]]$unmatched_interfaces

  unmatched %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      rsa %>%
        dplyr::select(
          chain,
          residue_number,
          rsa_residue_name = residue_name,
          RSA_total
        ),
      by = c(
        "chain",
        "residue_number"
      )
    )
}

check_unmatched_residues("6QZP")
check_unmatched_residues("8I0T")

# The mismatch originated from how FreeSASA and ChimeraX represent modified residues.


# ============================================================
# Per-complex structural proportions
# ============================================================

complex_structural_summary <-
  human_complex_residues %>%
  
  count(
    complex,
    pdb_id,
    structural_class,
    name = "n_residues"
  ) %>%
  
  group_by(
    complex,
    pdb_id
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    total_residues =
      sum(
        n_residues
      ),
    
    proportion =
      n_residues /
      total_residues,
    
    percentage =
      proportion *
      100
  ) %>%
  
  ungroup()




# Colors are always the same
structural_colors <- c(
  "Core" = "#A6B5C6",
  "Interface" = "#A9C6B0",
  "Non-interface Surface" = "#C5BFA0"
)


# Prepare the complex proportions 
complex_structural_summary <- complex_structural_summary %>%
  mutate(
    structural_class = factor(
      structural_class,
      levels = c(
        "Core",
        "Interface",
        "Non-interface Surface"
      )
    ),
    complex_label = case_when(
      complex == "replisome" ~ "Replisome (7PFO)",
      complex == "ribosome" ~ "Ribosome (6QZP)",
      complex == "spliceosome" ~ "Spliceosome (8I0T)",
      complex == "proteasome" ~ "Proteasome (6MSD)",
      TRUE ~ paste0(complex, " (", pdb_id, ")")
    )
  )

average_structural_summary <- complex_structural_summary %>%
  group_by(structural_class) %>%
  summarise(
    percentage = mean(percentage),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    complex_label = "Average"
  )

sum(average_structural_summary$percentage)

plot_structural_summary <- bind_rows(
  complex_structural_summary %>%
    select(
      complex_label,
      structural_class,
      percentage
    ),
  
  average_structural_summary %>%
    select(
      complex_label,
      structural_class,
      percentage
    )
)


# Generate the five donuts
p_replisome <- plot_structural_donut(
  plot_structural_summary %>%
    filter(
      complex_label == "Replisome (7PFO)"
    ),
  title = "Replisome (7PFO)"
)

p_ribosome <- plot_structural_donut(
  plot_structural_summary %>%
    filter(
      complex_label == "Ribosome (6QZP)"
    ),
  title = "Ribosome (6QZP)"
)

p_spliceosome <- plot_structural_donut(
  plot_structural_summary %>%
    filter(
      complex_label == "Spliceosome (8I0T)"
    ),
  title = "Spliceosome (8I0T)"
)

p_proteasome <- plot_structural_donut(
  plot_structural_summary %>%
    filter(
      complex_label == "Proteasome (6MSD)"
    ),
  title = "Proteasome (6MSD)"
)

p_average <- plot_structural_donut(
  plot_structural_summary %>%
    filter(
      complex_label == "Average"
    ),
  title = "Average"
)
# Add one shared legend
p_average <- p_average +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )

plot_complex_structural_composition <-
  (p_replisome | p_ribosome | p_spliceosome | p_proteasome | p_average | plot_spacer())

plot_complex_structural_composition

# Function to plot dunot proportion plots
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)

plot_structural_donut <- function(
    df,
    title,
    palette = structural_colors
) {
  
  df_plot <- df %>%
    mutate(
      structural_class = factor(
        structural_class,
        levels = c(
          "Core",
          "Interface",
          "Non-interface Surface"
        )
      ),
      proportion = percentage / 100,
      label = percent(
        proportion,
        accuracy = 0.1
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(structural_class)
  
  ggplot(
    df_plot,
    aes(
      x = 2,
      y = proportion,
      fill = structural_class
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.8,
      width = 0.9
    ) +
    
    coord_polar(
      theta = "y"
    ) +
    
    xlim(
      0.6,
      2.5
    ) +
    
    geom_text(
      aes(label = label),
      position = position_stack(
        vjust = 0.5
      ),
      size = 4
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = palette,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    
    labs(
      title = title,
      fill = NULL
    ) +
    
    theme_void() +
    
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold",
        size = 12
      ),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}


plot_structural_donut <- function(
    df,
    title,
    total_residues = NULL,
    palette = structural_colors
) {
  
  df_plot <- df %>%
    mutate(
      structural_class = factor(
        structural_class,
        levels = c(
          "Core",
          "Interface",
          "Non-interface Surface"
        )
      ),
      proportion = percentage / 100,
      label = percent(
        proportion,
        accuracy = 0.1
      )
    )
  
  p <- ggplot(
    df_plot,
    aes(
      x = 2,
      y = proportion,
      fill = structural_class
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.8,
      width = 0.9
    ) +
    coord_polar(theta = "y") +
    xlim(0.6, 2.5) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = label),
      position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
      size = 4
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = palette,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      fill = NULL
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold",
        size = 12
      ),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  
  if (!is.null(total_residues)) {
    
    p <- p +
      annotate(
        "text",
        x = 0,
        y = 0,
        label = paste0(
          "n = ",
          scales::comma(total_residues)
        ),
        size = 3.8
      )
  }
  
  p
}
